scholarsSessions.name: Dr. Ahmed Al-Farooq
scholarsSessions.bio: Dr. Al-Farooq has over 20 years of experience in Islamic studies and has authored numerous books on Islamic jurisprudence. He received his PhD from Al-Azhar University and has been a visiting scholar at several prestigious institutions worldwide.

scholarsSessions.name: 'Dr. Aisha Rahman'
scholarsSessions.bio: Dr. Rahman specializes in Quranic interpretation and has been teaching for 15 years at prestigious Islamic institutions. Her approach combines traditional and contemporary methodologies to make Quranic teachings accessible to modern audiences.

scholarsSessions.name: Sheikh Mustafa Kamal
scholarsSessions.bio: Sheikh Kamal is renowned for his deep knowledge of Hadith and has dedicated his life to spreading authentic Islamic knowledge. He has memorized over 5,000 hadiths with their chains of narration and is respected for his meticulous verification methods.

scholarsSessions.name: Dr. Fatima Al-Zahra
scholarsSessions.bio: Dr. Fatima is a leading expert in Islamic history with a focus on the golden age of Islamic civilization. Her research on the contributions of Muslims to science, medicine, and philosophy has been published in numerous academic journals.

scholarsSessions.name: Imam Yusuf Abdullah
scholarsSessions.bio: Imam Yusuf specializes in applying Islamic jurisprudence to contemporary issues. His balanced approach has helped many Muslims navigate modern challenges while staying true to their faith. He serves as an imam at one of the largest mosques in North America.

scholarsSessions.name: Dr. Zainab Malik
scholarsSessions.bio: Dr. Malik bridges the gap between modern psychology and Islamic teachings on mental well-being. Her innovative approach has helped thousands of Muslims address mental health concerns through faith-based practices combined with evidence-based psychological techniques.

scholarsSessions.name: Sheikh Omar Farooq
scholarsSessions.bio: Sheikh Omar is internationally recognized for his beautiful Quranic recitation and expertise in Tajweed rules. He has memorized the entire Quran and holds multiple ijazahs (certifications) in different recitation styles. His soothing voice has touched millions of hearts worldwide.

scholarsSessions.name: Dr. Yasir Qadhi
scholarsSessions.bio: Dr. Yasir Qadhi is a renowned Islamic scholar and academic.

scholarsSessions.name: Shaykh Omar Suleiman
scholarsSessions.bio: Shaykh Omar Suleiman is a respected teacher and speaker.

scholarsSessions.bio: Mufti Menk is a globally recognized Islamic scholar.
